content:
Maya Patel: FYI releasing embedding-service v2.1.0 in 15m (rolling canary). targeting embeddings-route only. 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
Ethan Ross: Which model weights are we pinning?
Maya Patel: Pin to weights emb-enc-v2-2026-03. rollback target is emb-enc-v2-2026-02.
Priya Shah: Request: add explicit eval gating for embedding drift. If semantic-similarity drop > 4% on our smoke set -> hold.
Maya Patel: Agree. Gate: semantic-drop >= 4% OR p95 latency increase >= 200ms sustained 3m -> pause promotion.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: rollout scheduled at 03:10 UTC for embedding-service v2.1.0. gating hooks: telemetry + evals.
release-coordinator: Please flag customer-impacting routes: embeddings-public and embeddings-paid. We should avoid touching embeddings-paid until canary is green.
ops-oncall: Who will make the final rollback call during first 30m?
Maya Patel: ops-oncall primary. Priya will hold product sign-off for customer routes.
Ethan Ross: Prep commands for rollback:
```
# revert canary slice
/releases/exec revert --service embedding-service --to emb-enc-v2-2026-02 --slice canary
# revert paid route only
/routes/update set --route embeddings-paid --version emb-enc-v2-2026-02
```
Priya Shah: Note: after any revert clear local cache and invalidate atlas-index: `/infra/cache invalidate --service embedding-index`
deploy-bot: Canary traffic shift: 5% -> v2.1.0. eval jobs queued: smoke-eval-embed-12. Baseline semantic-similarity = 0.912.
ops-oncall: First eval results coming in. p95 latency 105ms baseline.
Maya Patel: If eval shows regressions, hold and tag runtime team immediately.
deploy-bot: Smoke eval complete. semantic-similarity=0.873 (drop 4.3%). Flag: eval-gate-breach. :rotating_light:
ops-oncall: Seeing eval breach. Pausing promotion and opening bridge.
Ethan Ross: Can we narrow to surface area? Any per-customer regressions?
Priya Shah: Paid-route unaffected so far (still routed to previous weights). Only public-canary samples show drift.
Maya Patel: Since semantic drop > 4% on smoke set we should rollback the canary only. ops-oncall, please execute canary revert.
ops-oncall: Executing canary revert now:
```
/releases/exec revert --service embedding-service --to emb-enc-v2-2026-02 --slice canary --confirm
```
deploy-bot: Rolling canary back to emb-enc-v2-2026-02. Traffic shifting off v2.1.0.
ops-oncall: Revert complete. Canary slice back to previous weights. Monitoring latency/accuracy.
Maya Patel: Hold customer notes: post that we paused the public canary due to embedding quality regression in internal tests; no paid-customer impact. ETA next update 1.5h.
release-coordinator: Will draft a short announcement for #customer-updates and our incident log.
Ethan Ross: Follow-ups: add eval gate to CI with threshold 4%, add route-level staged rollout so paid routes remain isolated by default. I'll open PRs.
Priya Shah: I'll attach the smoke-eval logs and mark as post-release follow-up.
ops-oncall: All stable after revert: semantic-similarity back to 0.913, p95=98ms. Closing bridge in 12m if no objections.
Maya Patel: Thanks team. Manual canary revert executed, paid routes unchanged. Reopen only after model fix + new eval pass. :white_check_mark:
